Report 01 · Teleperformance – Healthcare Account

Prescription Drug Cost & Deductible Concern

Situation & Challenge

A Medicare member contacted UnitedHealthcare because she could not afford her prescribed medication. Since she had not yet met her applicable prescription drug deductible, she was responsible for the full applicable medication cost. She was worried about the financial burden and needed assistance finding a more affordable option.

Actions & Resolution

  • Completed member identity verification before accessing account information
  • Reviewed prescription benefits and deductible status
  • Explained why the member was responsible for the medication cost
  • Used critical thinking and available resources to identify a potentially lower-cost medication with a similar therapeutic purpose
  • Recommended consulting the prescribing physician before considering an alternative

Call Scenario

Customer
I'm having trouble affording my medication. I was surprised by the price at the pharmacy because I thought my insurance would cover it.
Representative
I understand your concern, and I'm sorry you're experiencing this. I'd be happy to look into your prescription coverage and explore what options may be available. Before we proceed, may I verify your information?
Customer
Sure.
Representative
Thank you for completing the verification. Please allow me a moment while I review your benefits.
Representative
After reviewing your benefits, I found that you haven't met your applicable prescription drug deductible yet, which is why you're currently responsible for the medication cost.
Customer
I really need this medication, but I can't afford to keep paying that much.
Representative
I completely understand. Let me explore the available resources to see if there's another option that may help reduce your expenses.
Representative
I found a potentially lower-cost alternative medication with a similar therapeutic purpose. I recommend discussing it with your prescribing physician to determine if it's medically appropriate for you.
Customer
That would be really helpful. Thank you for looking into that for me.
Representative
You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help provide another option.

Outcome

Successfully addressed the member's concern by clarifying her prescription benefits and identifying a potential cost-saving alternative. The member appreciated the initiative and expressed gratitude for the assistance provided.

Skills Demonstrated

Critical Thinking Problem-Solving Empathy Healthcare Benefits Knowledge Resource Navigation Identity Verification Active Listening

Report 02 · Foundever – Financial Account

Lost Credit Card & Unauthorized Transaction

Situation & Challenge

A customer contacted PNC Bank after losing his credit card and discovering an unauthorized transaction on his statement. He was extremely upset and initially refused identity verification, believing the transaction should have been automatically declined.

Actions & Resolution

  • Demonstrated empathy and acknowledged the customer's frustration
  • Successfully de-escalated the situation and gained the customer's cooperation
  • Explained the importance of identity verification and account security
  • Reported the unauthorized transaction, locked the compromised card, and processed a replacement card

Call Scenario

Customer
I lost my credit card, and now there's an unauthorized transaction on my account! Why wasn't this transaction declined? I don't want to go through verification again!
Representative
I completely understand your frustration. If I were in your situation, I would feel the same way. Please allow me to help you sort this out.
Customer
Why do you still need to verify me? I just want this fixed!
Representative
I understand. Verification is an important security measure to ensure we're speaking with the authorized account holder and to protect your account from unauthorized access. Once we complete this step, I'll be able to assist you with reporting the transaction and securing your card.
Customer
Alright, let's proceed.
Representative
Thank you for your cooperation. I've successfully reported the unauthorized transaction, locked your lost card, and processed a replacement card for you.
Customer
Thank you for helping me. I'll make sure to give you a good survey after this call.

Outcome

Successfully addressed the customer's concerns and secured the compromised card. The customer ended the call satisfied and proactively expressed his intention to provide a positive survey.

Skills Demonstrated

Empathy Critical Thinking Customer De-escalation Fraud Awareness Active Listening Problem-Solving Account Security

Report 03 · TSI – US Utility Account & Sales

Urgent Disconnection Notice & Insurance Sales Opportunity

Situation & Challenge

A customer contacted Duke Energy in distress because her electricity was scheduled for disconnection within 24 hours. Her father, who lived in the same household, relied on an oxygen machine. Although they could pay the outstanding balance, they needed four additional days to secure the funds.

Actions & Resolution

  • Completed account verification and assessed the customer's situation
  • Demonstrated empathy and prioritized the urgency of the medical circumstances
  • Explored installment arrangements but identified that the customer had reached the maximum limit
  • Took initiative by checking eligibility and successfully processing a courtesy extension
  • Identified a sales opportunity and pitched Duke Energy's optional home wiring protection insurance product
  • Successfully converted the offer into an enrollment, contributing to sales and conversation conversion performance

Call Scenario

Customer
Please, I really need your help. My electricity is scheduled for disconnection tomorrow, and my father is using an oxygen machine. We can pay the bill, but we just need four more days.
Representative
I completely understand your situation, and I know how important it is to keep your electricity running, especially with your father's medical needs. Let me review your account and see what options are available.
Representative
After completing verification, I've checked your account for available installment arrangements. Unfortunately, you've already reached the maximum limit for that option. However, let me check if you're eligible for a courtesy extension.
Representative
Good news! You're still eligible for a courtesy extension, and I've successfully processed it to give you additional time to settle your balance.
Customer
Thank you so much! I promise we'll pay as soon as we have the money.
Representative
You're very welcome! Also, since storms are common in your area, I'd like to introduce an optional home wiring protection plan that may help protect your electrical wiring. Would you be interested in learning more?
Customer
Yes, that sounds helpful. I'd like to get that.
Representative
Absolutely! Let me walk you through the coverage and enrollment details.
Customer
Thank you again. I'll definitely leave you a good survey for helping us.

Outcome

Successfully provided the customer with additional time to settle the outstanding balance and avoid immediate disconnection. Additionally, converted the conversation into a successful insurance product enrollment. The customer expressed gratitude and proactively promised to provide a positive survey.

Skills Demonstrated

Empathy Critical Thinking Problem-Solving Urgent Call Handling Payment Assistance Sales Conversion Product Pitching Customer Relationship Management

Report 04 · TSD Global – Telecommunications Business-to-Business Campaign

Billing Dispute & Customer Retention

Situation & Challenge

A business customer contacted the company upset because a previous representative had promised that adding a smartwatch would lower his monthly bill. However, his bill increased instead, leading him to consider canceling all his lines.

Actions & Resolution

  • Acknowledged the customer's frustration and apologized for the misinformation
  • Completed account verification and reviewed the billing details
  • Identified that the smartwatch discount was scheduled to reflect on the following billing cycle
  • Reviewed each device and line individually to identify cost-saving opportunities
  • Adjusted eligible plans and applied available discounts to help lower the customer's monthly bill
  • Successfully addressed the customer's concern and retained the active lines

Call Scenario

Customer
I was told my bill would go down if I added a smartwatch, but now my bill is even higher. I want to cancel all my lines.
Representative
I sincerely apologize for the confusion and for the information you were previously given. I understand why you're frustrated. Let me verify your account and review the charges so I can see what happened and what options are available.
Customer
I just want to cancel everything. This isn't what I agreed to.
Representative
I understand your decision. After reviewing your account, I found that the discount was applied when the smartwatch was added, but it was scheduled to reflect on your next billing cycle. I'm sorry this wasn't properly explained to you. Before we proceed with cancellation, may I review your current plans and see if there are other ways to help lower your monthly bill?
Customer
Okay, what can you do?
Representative
I reviewed each line individually and found opportunities to adjust some of your plans and apply available discounts to eligible lines. These changes can help reduce your monthly expenses while keeping your services active.
Customer
That sounds better. I'll keep the lines.

Outcome

The customer understood the billing situation and was satisfied with the adjustments made to the account. Instead of proceeding with cancellation, the customer decided to keep all lines active.

Skills Demonstrated

Customer Retention & Loyalty Objection Handling Billing Analysis Empathy & Active Listening Negotiation & Persuasion Problem-Solving Account Management Sales & Retention Strategies
